task_intent: Refine Tessera setup and calibration flows.

mobbin.observed: A single physical action sits beneath a vivid, bounded product illustration. Compact stage progress does not compete with the task.
mobbin.applied: One decision per screen with a dedicated first-light stage, three compact section indicators and a stable bottom action.

mobbin.observed: The room illustration explains the object, while available-device identity and searching status remain separate.
mobbin.applied: Separate the authored welcome study from actual live wall frames and show the answering host beneath the found state.

mobbin.observed: Pairing confirmation offers two concrete outcomes: the device flashed, or it did not. Recovery is available without leaving the flow.
mobbin.applied: Five-second glow has yes/no outcomes, retry and skip; asynchronous restoration is handled by the shared temporary-display lease.

mobbin.observed: Local Network access is explained before discovery, with a help route close to the connect action.
mobbin.applied: Explain the iOS prompt in discovery and provide inline network troubleshooting plus a direct app-settings action, without falsely diagnosing denied permission.

mobbin.observed: An isolated product group provides visual focus, with concise setup text and an anchored primary action.
mobbin.applied: A framed panel, warm room planes and one bottom action create object-first composition; canonical Services handles account configuration.

primary_sources.applied: Keep first run optional, brief and connected to real interaction. All steps retain a finish-later path.
Describe Local Network permission accurately and offer Settings recovery. Lack of a discovery result is not treated as proof of denial.
Use Dynamic Type, VoiceOver step and live-source labels, scrollable content, persistent actions and no required movement.

assets.welcome_study: Authored deterministic 64x64 RGB weave in OnboardingLightStudy. Clearly labelled first-light study, never sent to wall or presented as live.
assets.room_stage: Native SwiftUI Canvas room geometry, not a stock image.
